description_en: Checks whether DuckDB-based analytical instances can be created for the specified RDS for PostgreSQL primary instance. If DuckDB-based analytical instances cannot be created, this operation returns the failure causes and provides solutions or recommended specification values
description_zh: 该接口用于检查RDS PostgreSQL主实例是否满足创建DuckDB分析实例的前提条件。对于不满足的条件将返回失败原因，并提供解决方案或建议的目标值
name: PrecheckDuckDBDependency

FailedCheckItems.description_en: The check items that do not meet the requirements for creating DuckDB-based analytical instances
FailedCheckItems.description_zh: 不符合创建DuckDB分析实例的条目

AllowAutoModify.description_en:
Indicates whether the item can be changed with one click to meet the requirements.

true: Yes. You can call the [ModifyDBInstanceConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2623684.html） operation to change the item with one click.
false: No.

If the major engine version of the primary does not meet the requirements, you must manually upgrade it
AllowAutoModify.description_zh:
是否可以一键修复。

true：是。可以通过调用[ModifyDBInstanceConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2623684.html）接口一键修复。
false：否。


<notice>当数据库实例大版本不符合要求时，需要通过[手动升级]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2623684.html）。></notice>

CurrentValue.description_en: The current value of the check item

Name.description_en: The name of the check item

RequiredValue.description_en: The value or value range that meets the requirements
RequiredValue.description_zh: 检查项的目标值（或目标区间）

Type.description_en:
The check item. Valid values:

Parameter: The parameters of the primary instance.
MinorVersion: The minor engine version of the primary instance.
MajorVersion: The major engine version of the primary instance
Type.description_zh:
检查项。取值：

Parameter：参数。
MinorVersion：内核小版本。
MajorVersion：数据库大版本

Result.description_en:
Indicates whether the primary instance meet the requirements for creating DuckDB-based analytical instances. Valid values:

true
false
Result.description_zh:
是否通过创建DuckDB分析实例的前置校验。取值：

true：是。
false：否
